ranking: Exact-equality midranks, lower score is safer. Spearman is Pearson on midranks.
concordance: Concordant divided by concordant plus discordant pairs; ties in either metric excluded and counted separately.
route_basis: Fixed equal mean of windows256/1024, per document, same as frozen scorer aggregation. Per-window ranking statistics remain fully reported as diagnostics.
route_requires: At least one opposite pair in either historical document; both full-roster midrank gaps >=3. No Future-KL used.
phase_b_pair_selection: Both independent new documents must separately qualify; descending min-gap then ordered scientific-key lexicographic tie-break; no relaxation.
partial_association: Pearson of predictor and historical-target midrank residuals after intercept plus rank(L7_TOTAL). Constant residual is unavailable, not zero.
roundoff_guard: Squared residual norm <= (32*float64_epsilon)^2 * max(1, centered rank norm) has no numerically reliable residual variance. Does not affect any route or scientific score.
sensitivity: Leave one rotation out and recompute all midranks, Spearman, concordance and partial association; omit no counterexamples.
historical_labels_scope: DISCOVERY_ONLY: pulse prefix, then no-further-QDQ continuation; four anchors are two independent documents; cross-runtime exploratory association only.
